title: The Share of the Base That Carries Forward on a Healthy Options Card
content:
How much of the base carries out of a closing benefit period on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is settled by the card's carry-forward term and by whether an allowance was loaded for that period.

**The rule.** The share that carries forward is the whole of the base it is measured on, where the card lets an unspent allowance carry forward in full and an allowance was loaded for that period; it is half of that base, where the card lets an unspent allowance carry forward up to half of a period's allowance and an allowance was loaded for that period; and it is nothing in every other case.

| The card's carry-forward term | A scheduled load stands for the closing period | The share that carries forward | As a share of the base |
|---|---|---|---|
| carries an unspent allowance forward in full, that is up to 100 per cent of a period's load | yes | the whole of the base it is measured on | 1 |
| carries an unspent allowance forward up to half, that is up to 50 per cent of a period's load | yes | half of the base it is measured on | 0.5 |
| either term | no | nothing | 0 |
| carries nothing forward | any | nothing | 0 |

A card whose term allows 100 per cent satisfies the first row; a card whose term allows 50 per cent satisfies the second. Whether a scheduled load stands for the closing period is read from the card's own scheduled load entries carrying that benefit period.

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.** A card whose term carries an unspent allowance forward in full, with a scheduled load standing for the closing period and a base of 135.00 USD: the share that carries forward is the whole 135.00 USD. A card whose term carries it forward up to half, on the same base: 67.50 USD. A card of either kind with no scheduled load standing for that period: nothing.
